extraction_notes: SI catalytic-performance figures digitised: SI Figures S13, S14, S15 and S33. Smooth polynomial fits/shaded bands in SI Figure S14 were not digitised; only measured markers were reported. SI Figure S34 was skipped because it reports deactivation constants, not the requested performance quantities.
